     5	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivRankOneOpen
     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOneNativePresentation
     7	
     8	/-!
     9	# Assembly from a rank-one divisor-fibre pullback
    10	
    11	This file isolates the last presheaf step in the arbitrary-scheme rank-one fibre construction.
    12	Its input ties an open `W` to the displayed family, supplies native presentations on every
    13	affine pullback, and supplies the canonical evaluation-divisor classifier.  The geometric input
    14	to the assembly theorem is the genuine pullback square of that evaluation divisor along Abel.
    15	The universal property of this stronger square produces, rather than assumes, the factorisation
    16	field of `PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented`.
    17	
    18	The global construction of the canonical classifier and its represented pullbacks remains an
    19	upstream obligation.  The endpoint here keeps that obligation in its geometric `IsPullback`
    20	form and feeds the resulting arbitrary-scheme fibres immediately to
    21	`picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_fibrePresented`.
    22	
    23	Thus this module is a conditional assembly interface, not the missing global producer: no
    24	declaration below constructs the evaluator, the open family, or its pullback theorem.
    25	-/
    26	
    27	set_option autoImplicit false
    28	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    29	
    30	universe u
    31	
    32	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
    33	  CartesianMonoidalCategory
    34	
    35	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    36	
    37	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    38	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    39	
    40	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    41	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    42	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    43	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    44	
    45	noncomputable section
    46	
    47	abbrev rankOneAmbient : Schemeᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u :=
    48	  Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
    49	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))
    50	
    51	abbrev rankOneLocus : Schemeᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u :=
    52	  Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor
    53	
    54	/-- The divisor families whose Abel class has a rank-one presentation, extended to the big site. -/
    55	abbrev rankOneDivisorLocus : Schemeᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u :=
    56	  Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
    57	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).toFunctor
    58	
    59	/-- The restricted represented Abel map on the big site. -/
    60	def rankOneAbelSigma :
    61	    rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) ⟶
    62	      rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) :=
    63	  Over.sigmaExtensionNat (rankOneAbelRepresented pi)
    64	
    65	/-- The ambient class of a divisor already known to lie in the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
    66	def rankOneDivisorToAmbient :
    67	    rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C) :=
    68	  rankOneAbelSigma pi ≫ picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi
    69	
    70	/-! ## The explicit geometric input -/
    71	
    72	/-- The single canonical evaluation-divisor classifier used by every represented fibre.
    73	
    74	Keeping this datum outside `PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput` prevents the classifier from
    75	varying with the test scheme or displayed family. -/
    76	structure PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData where
    77	  divisor : rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) ⟶
    78	    rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi)
    79	  divisor_abel : divisor ≫ rankOneAbelSigma pi = 𝟙 _
    80	
    81	namespace PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData
    82	
    83	/-- Applying restricted Abel to the canonical evaluation divisor recovers its rank-one class. -/
    84	lemma divisor_abel_app (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi)
    85	    (S : Scheme.{u}) (v : (rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi)).obj (op S)) :
    86	    (rankOneAbelSigma pi).app (op S) (E.divisor.app (op S) v) = v := by
    87	  exact congrArg (fun q => q.app (op S) v) E.divisor_abel
    88	
    89	/-- The canonical divisor has the original ambient Picard class. -/
    90	lemma divisor_toAmbient (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi) :
    91	    E.divisor ≫ rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi = picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi := by
    92	  rw [rankOneDivisorToAmbient, ← Category.assoc, E.divisor_abel, Category.id_comp]
    93	
    94	/-- The separate uniqueness obligation saying every divisor in the rank-one presentation
    95	preimage is the canonical evaluation divisor of its Abel class. -/
    96	def AbelInverse (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi) : Prop :=
    97	  rankOneAbelSigma pi ≫ E.divisor = 𝟙 _
    98	
    99	/-- Once divisor uniqueness is proved, restricted Abel and canonical evaluation form the
   100	rank-one family isomorphism. -/
   101	def evaluationIso (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi) (h : E.AbelInverse) :
   102	    rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) ≅ rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) where
   103	  hom := rankOneAbelSigma pi
   104	  inv := E.divisor
   105	  hom_inv_id := h
   106	  inv_hom_id := E.divisor_abel
   107	
   108	end PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData
   109	
   110	/--
   111	The explicit data needed to assemble one arbitrary-scheme rank-one fibre.
   112	
   113	`restrictedValue` is the restriction of the displayed ambient family to `W`, and
   114	`nativePresentation` quantifies over every affine pullback of that value.  The parameter `E` is
   115	the common evaluation-divisor classifier on the rank-one locus, with its Abel compatibility
   116	kept explicit.  Divisor representability is deliberately not a field of this structure: it is
   117	supplied separately as a pullback square to the assembly theorem.
   118	
   119	In particular, no field-fibre dimension witness, unrelated line bundle, or pre-existing
   120	`PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented` is accepted by this contract.  Conversely, this structure is not
   121	itself a producer: an inhabitant must still supply the arbitrary-affine native presentations.
   122	-/
   123	structure PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput
   124	    (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi)
   125	    {X : Scheme.{u}}
   126	    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C)) where
   127	  W : X.Opens
   128	  restrictedValue : rankOneAmbient (C := C).obj (op (W : Scheme.{u}))
   129	  restrictedValue_eq :
   130	    restrictedValue =
   131	      (yoneda.map W.ι ≫ g).app (op (W : Scheme.{u})) (𝟙 (W : Scheme.{u}))
   132	  /-- The tied native presentation on every affine pullback of the restricted family value. -/
   133	  nativePresentation :
   134	    ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   135	      (t : overSpec k A ⟶ Over.mk restrictedValue.1),
   136	      Nonempty (PicRankOneNativePresentation pi
   137	        ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op restrictedValue.2))
   138	
   139	namespace PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput
   140	
   141	variable {X : Scheme.{u}}
   142	variable {g : yoneda.obj X ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C)}
   143	variable {E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi}
   144	
   145	/-- The public-locus element carried by the restricted family value over `W`. -/
   146	noncomputable def locusValue (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
   147	    rankOneLocus.obj (op (F.W : Scheme.{u})) :=
   148	  ⟨F.restrictedValue.1, ⟨F.restrictedValue.2,
   149	    mem_picRankOneOpen_of_nativePresentations pi
   150	      (fun A _ _ t => F.nativePresentation A t)⟩⟩
   151	
   152	/-- The map into the public locus is obtained from its universal element by Yoneda. -/
   153	noncomputable def fst (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
   154	    yoneda.obj (F.W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶ rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) :=
   155	  yonedaEquiv.symm F.locusValue
   156	
   157	/-- The canonical evaluation divisor of the restricted family value over `W`. -/
   158	noncomputable def evaluationDivisor
   159	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
   160	    yoneda.obj (F.W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶ rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) :=
   161	  F.fst ≫ E.divisor
   162	
   163	/-- The factorisation clause required by `PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented`, exposed as the target
   164	of the represented evaluation-divisor argument below. -/
   165	def FibreFactorizationClause
   166	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) : Prop :=
   167	  ∀ (S : Scheme.{u}) (v : rankOneLocus.obj (op S)) (w : S ⟶ X),
   168	    (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op S) v =
   169	      g.app (op S) w →
   170	    ∃ u : S ⟶ (F.W : Scheme.{u}),
   171	      F.fst.app (op S) u = v ∧ u ≫ F.W.ι = w
   172	
   173	lemma fst_comp_incl (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
   174	    F.fst ≫ picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi = yoneda.map F.W.ι ≫ g := by
   175	  apply yonedaEquiv.injective
   176	  change (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op (F.W : Scheme.{u})) F.locusValue =
   177	    (yoneda.map F.W.ι ≫ g).app (op (F.W : Scheme.{u})) (𝟙 (F.W : Scheme.{u}))
   178	  dsimp [locusValue, picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl,
   179	    CategoryTheory.Over.sigmaExtensionNat]
   180	  rw [← F.restrictedValue_eq]
   181	
   182	/-- The family evaluation divisor has the displayed family as its Abel class. -/
   183	lemma evaluationDivisor_abel
   184	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
   185	    F.evaluationDivisor ≫ rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi =
   186	      yoneda.map F.W.ι ≫ g := by
   187	  rw [evaluationDivisor, Category.assoc, E.divisor_toAmbient]
   188	  exact F.fst_comp_incl
   189	
   190	/-! ## The represented rank-one-divisor fibre square -/
   191	
   192	/-- The open `W` represents the pullback of the restricted divisor-class map along the displayed
   193	family, with its top map fixed by the canonical evaluation divisor.  This is stronger than the
   194	factorisation clause for the public rank-one locus: it is a categorical pullback against the
   195	entire restricted rank-one divisor presheaf. -/
   196	def EvaluationDivisorPullback
   197	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) : Prop :=
   198	  IsPullback
   199	    F.evaluationDivisor
   200	    (yoneda.map F.W.ι)
   201	    (rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi)
   202	    g
   203	
   204	/-- The represented evaluation-divisor square produces the public-locus factorisation on every
   205	test scheme. -/
   206	lemma fibreFactorizationClause_of_evaluationDivisorPullback
   207	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
   208	    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
   209	    F.FibreFactorizationClause := by
   210	  intro S v w hvw
   211	  have hS := (IsPullback.iff_app.mp hpb) (op S)
   212	  rw [Types.isPullback_iff] at hS
   213	  have hcompat :
   214	      (rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi).app (op S)
   215	          (E.divisor.app (op S) v) =
   216	        g.app (op S) w := by
   217	    have h := congrArg
   218	      (fun q => q.app (op S) v) E.divisor_toAmbient
   219	    change
   220	      (rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi).app (op S)
   221	          (E.divisor.app (op S) v) =
   222	        (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op S) v at h
   223	    rw [h]
   224	    exact hvw
   225	  obtain ⟨u, huDivisor, huW⟩ :=
   226	    hS.2.2 (E.divisor.app (op S) v) w hcompat
   227	  change E.divisor.app (op S) (F.fst.app (op S) u) =
   228	    E.divisor.app (op S) v at huDivisor
   229	  change u ≫ F.W.ι = w at huW
   230	  refine ⟨u, ?_, huW⟩
   231	  calc
   232	    F.fst.app (op S) u =
   233	        (rankOneAbelSigma pi).app (op S)
   234	          (E.divisor.app (op S) (F.fst.app (op S) u)) :=
   235	      (E.divisor_abel_app S (F.fst.app (op S) u)).symm
   236	    _ = (rankOneAbelSigma pi).app (op S) (E.divisor.app (op S) v) :=
   237	      congrArg _ huDivisor
   238	    _ = v := E.divisor_abel_app S v
   239	
   240	/-! ## Assembly of the stronger fibre datum -/
   241	
   242	/-- Assemble the public fibre presentation from the represented canonical evaluation-divisor
   243	square.  Its `exists_factor` field is derived from the pullback universal property. -/
   244	noncomputable def toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback
   245	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
   246	    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
   247	    PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented pi g where
   248	  W := F.W
   249	  fst := F.fst
   250	  sq := F.fst_comp_incl
   251	  exists_factor := by
   252	    simpa only [FibreFactorizationClause] using
   253	      F.fibreFactorizationClause_of_evaluationDivisorPullback hpb
   254	
   255	@[simp]
   256	lemma toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback_W
   257	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
   258	    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
   259	    (F.toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback hpb).W = F.W :=
   260	  rfl
   261	
   262	lemma toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback_isPullback
   263	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
   264	    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
   265	    IsPullback F.fst (yoneda.map F.W.ι) (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi) g :=
   266	  (F.toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback hpb).isPullback
   267	
   268	/-! ## Immediate openness consumer -/
   269	
   270	theorem picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_evaluationDivisorPullbackFamilies
   271	    (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi)
   272	    (D : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
   273	      (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C)),
   274	      PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
   275	    (hpb : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
   276	      (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C)),
   277	      (D X g).EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
   278	    PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi := by
   279	  apply picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_fibrePresented pi
   280	  intro X g
   281	  exact (D X g).toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback (hpb X g)
   282	
   283	end PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput
   284	
   285	end
   286	end AlgebraicGeometry

     9	/-!
    10	# The universal divisor rank-one open contract
    11	
    12	The genus divisor representer is unconditional, while the rank-one restriction still needs a
    13	family-level open-locus producer.  This file separates those two facts.  The predicate below is
    14	the inverse image of `PicRankOneOpen` along the represented universal Abel map.  A
    15	`DivRankOneOpenData` witness identifies that predicate with the range of one actual open of the
    16	representer; only after that witness is supplied do we define the open subscheme.
    17	
    18	This shape prevents a logical `Subfunctor` from being silently reinterpreted as a scheme.  It also
    19	gives the canonical inverse lane a stable contract: it consumes the witness equality and can use
    20	the resulting open inclusion and all of its pullbacks without choosing a generator.
    21	-/
    22	
    23	set_option autoImplicit false
    24	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    25	
    26	universe u
    27	
    28	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
    29	
    30	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    31	
    32	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    33	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    34	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    35	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    36	
    37	noncomputable section

    39	/-- The universal genus-divisor predicate whose Abel class lies in `PicRankOneOpen`. -/
    40	def divRankOneUniversalPredicate :
    41	    Subfunctor (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)) :=
    42	  divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi
    43	
    44	/-- Evaluation of the represented genus Abel map on a slice point, with the base morphism
    45	transported from the point in the divisor representer to its source. -/
    46	theorem abelDivAffGenusSigma_app_left_rankOne
    47	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    48	    (q : T ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C) :
    49	    (abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op T.left) q.left =
    50	      (⟨T.hom,
    51	        (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T)
    52	          ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q)⟩ :
    53	        (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
    54	          (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))).obj (op T.left)) := by
    55	  change (⟨q.left ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom, _⟩ :
    56	      (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
    57	        (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))).obj (op T.left)) =
    58	    ⟨T.hom,
    59	      (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T)
    60	        ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q)⟩
    61	  refine Over.sigmaExtension_ext
    62	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) q.w ?_
    63	  let e : Over.mk (q.left ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom) ⟶ T :=
    64	    Over.mkCongr q.w
    65	  let q' : Over.mk (q.left ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom) ⟶
    66	      divRepAffGenusScheme C :=
    67	    Over.homMk q.left rfl
    68	  have hq : e ≫ q = q' := by
    69	    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    70	    exact Category.id_comp _
    71	  change (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map e.op
    72	      ((abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T)
    73	        ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q)) =
    74	    (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app
    75	      (op (Over.mk (q.left ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom)))
    76	      ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q')
    77	  have hnat := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    78	    ((abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).naturality e.op)
    79	      ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q)
    80	  have hhom :
    81	      (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q' =
    82	        (divFunctorAff C (genus C)).map e.op
    83	          ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q) := by
    84	    calc
    85	      (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q' =
    86	          (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv (e ≫ q) := by
    87	            rw [hq]
    88	      _ = (divFunctorAff C (genus C)).map e.op
    89	          ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q) :=
    90	        (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv_comp e q
    91	  rw [hhom]
    92	  simpa only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] using hnat.symm

    94	/-- A represented genus divisor lies in the universal predicate exactly when its Abel image
    95	lifts through the single public rank-one Picard locus. -/
    96	theorem divRankOneUniversalPredicate_mem_iff_sigma
    97	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    98	    (x : (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)).obj T) :
    99	    x ∈ (divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi).obj T ↔
   100	      ∃ v : (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
   101	          (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor).obj (op T.unop.left),
   102	        (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op T.unop.left) v =
   103	          (abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op T.unop.left) x.left := by
   104	  simp only [divRankOneUniversalPredicate,
   105	    divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter,
   106	    Subfunctor.preimage_obj, Set.mem_preimage]
   107	  let p := (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app T
   108	    ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv x)
   109	  change p ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T ↔ _
   110	  have hleft :
   111	      (abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op T.unop.left) x.left =
   112	        (⟨T.unop.hom, p⟩ :
   113	          (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
   114	            (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))).obj
   115	              (op T.unop.left)) :=
   116	    abelDivAffGenusSigma_app_left_rankOne x
   117	  constructor
   118	  · intro hp
   119	    refine ⟨⟨T.unop.hom, ⟨p, hp⟩⟩, ?_⟩
   120	    rw [hleft]
   121	    rfl
   122	  · rintro ⟨v, hv⟩
   123	    rw [hleft] at hv
   124	    dsimp [picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl,
   125	      CategoryTheory.Over.sigmaExtensionNat] at hv
   126	    rcases v with ⟨a, y⟩
   127	    dsimp at hv
   128	    have hfirst : a = T.unop.hom :=
   129	      congrArg (fun z => z.1) hv
   130	    cases hfirst
   131	    have hinj := Sigma.mk.inj hv
   132	    have heq :
   133	        ConcreteCategory.hom
   134	            ((PicRankOneOpen pi).ι.app
   135	              (op (Over.mk T.unop.hom))) y = p :=
   136	      eq_of_heq hinj.2
   137	    change p ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T
   138	    rw [← heq]
   139	    exact y.property
   140	
   141	/-- The Yoneda map induced by the inclusion of an open of an object in the slice.  Naming this
   142	map is useful to consumers which need the actual factorisation through the open, rather than only
   143	the proposition that a point lies in its range. -/
   144	def openSubfunctorMap (D : Over (Spec (.of k))) (U : D.left.Opens) :
   145	    yoneda.obj (Over.mk (U.ι ≫ D.hom)) ⟶ yoneda.obj D :=
   146	  yoneda.map (Over.homMk (U := Over.mk (U.ι ≫ D.hom)) U.ι)
   147	
   148	/-- The subfunctor represented by an open `U` of an object `D` in the slice over `Spec k`.
   149	
   150	Its values are precisely morphisms which factor through the open immersion `U.ι`; using the
   151	Yoneda range keeps this definition independent of any chosen affine presentation of `U`. -/
   152	def openSubfunctor (D : Over (Spec (.of k))) (U : D.left.Opens) :
   153	    Subfunctor (yoneda.obj D) :=
   154	  Subfunctor.range (openSubfunctorMap D U)
   155	
   156	/-- Unpack range membership into the actual source point and its equality in the ambient Yoneda
   157	functor.  This is the pointwise factorisation API used by inverse constructions. -/
   158	theorem openSubfunctor_mem_iff
   159	    (D : Over (Spec (.of k))) (U : D.left.Opens)
   160	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   161	    (x : (yoneda.obj D).obj T) :
   162	    x ∈ (openSubfunctor D U).obj T ↔
   163	      ∃ y : (yoneda.obj (Over.mk (U.ι ≫ D.hom))).obj T,
   164	        (openSubfunctorMap D U).app T y = x := by
   165	  rfl
   166	
   167	/-- An explicit geometric certificate for the universal rank-one predicate.
   168	
   169	The equality is the missing family-level producer/gluing statement: it identifies the logical
   170	preimage with an actual open of the canonical genus representer.  No default or top-open witness
   171	is manufactured here. -/
   172	structure DivRankOneOpenData (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi] where
   173	  carrier : (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left.Opens
   174	  carrier_eq :
   175	    openSubfunctor (divRepAffGenusScheme C) carrier =
   176	      divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi
   177	
   178	/-- Genuine relative openness of the public Picard rank-one locus produces the universal
   179	divisor rank-one open.  The carrier is the open image of the represented pullback of the Abel
   180	map, and the proof below identifies its Yoneda range with the defining predicate. -/
   181	theorem divRankOneOpenData_of_picRankOneOpen_isOpen
   182	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi) :
   183	    Nonempty (DivRankOneOpenData pi) := by
   184	  obtain ⟨X, snd, fst, hpb⟩ := h.rep (abelDivAffGenusSigma C)
   185	  letI : IsOpenImmersion snd :=
   186	    h.property (abelDivAffGenusSigma C) fst snd hpb
   187	  let U := snd.opensRange
   188	  refine ⟨⟨U, ?_⟩⟩
   189	  ext T x
   190	  rw [openSubfunctor_mem_iff]
   191	  rw [divRankOneUniversalPredicate_mem_iff_sigma]
   192	  have hpbT := (IsPullback.iff_app.mp hpb) (op T.unop.left)
   193	  rw [Types.isPullback_iff] at hpbT
   194	  constructor
   195	  · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
   196	    have hxy : x.left = y.left ≫ U.ι := by
   197	      have hleft := congrArg Over.Hom.left hy
   198	      exact hleft.symm
   199	    have hrange : Set.range x.left.base ⊆ Set.range snd.base := by
   200	      rw [← Scheme.Hom.coe_opensRange snd]
   201	      rintro z ⟨t, rfl⟩
   202	      rw [hxy, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
   203	      change U.ι.base (y.left.base t) ∈ snd.opensRange
   204	      change U.ι.base (y.left.base t) ∈ U
   205	      exact (y.left.base t).property
   206	    let u : T.unop.left ⟶ X :=
   207	      IsOpenImmersion.lift snd x.left hrange
   208	    have hu : u ≫ snd = x.left :=
   209	      IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _
   210	    refine ⟨fst.app (op T.unop.left) u, ?_⟩
   211	    have hcomm := congrArg
   212	      (fun f => (ConcreteCategory.hom f) u) hpbT.1
   213	    change (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op T.unop.left)
   214	        (fst.app (op T.unop.left) u) =
   215	      (abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op T.unop.left) (u ≫ snd) at hcomm
   216	    simpa only [hu] using hcomm
   217	  · rintro ⟨v, hv⟩
   218	    obtain ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩ := hpbT.2.2 v x.left hv
   219	    change u ≫ snd = x.left at hu₂
   220	    have hrange : Set.range x.left.base ⊆ Set.range U.ι.base := by
   221	      rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
   222	      change Set.range x.left.base ⊆ snd.opensRange
   223	      rw [Scheme.Hom.coe_opensRange]
   224	      rintro z ⟨t, rfl⟩
   225	      refine ⟨u.base t, ?_⟩
   226	      have happ := congrArg (fun f => f.base t) hu₂
   227	      simpa only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] using happ
   228	    let V : Over (Spec (.of k)) :=
   229	      Over.mk (U.ι ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom)
   230	    let j : V ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C :=
   231	      Over.homMk (U := V) U.ι
   232	    let e : U.toScheme = V.left := rfl
   233	    let l : T.unop.left ⟶ U.toScheme :=
   234	      IsOpenImmersion.lift U.ι x.left hrange
   235	    let l' : T.unop.left ⟶ V.left := l ≫ eqToHom e
   236	    have he : eqToHom e ≫ j.left = U.ι := by
   237	      subst e
   238	      rfl
   239	    have hl : l' ≫ j.left = x.left := by
   240	      dsimp only [l']
   241	      rw [Category.assoc, he]
   242	      dsimp only [l]
   243	      exact IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _
   244	    have hlw : l' ≫ V.hom = T.unop.hom := by
   245	      rw [← j.w, ← Category.assoc, hl]
   246	      exact x.w
   247	    let y : (yoneda.obj V).obj T := Over.homMk l' hlw
   248	    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
   249	    change y ≫ j = x
   250	    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
   251	    exact hl

   253	/-- A named carrier choice for consumers which already possess the Picard openness theorem. -/
   254	def divRankOneOpenDataOfPicRankOneOpen
   255	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi) : DivRankOneOpenData pi :=
   256	  Classical.choice (divRankOneOpenData_of_picRankOneOpen_isOpen pi h)
   257	
   258	/-- The open subscheme supplied by a `DivRankOneOpenData` witness. -/
   259	def DivRankOneOpen (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi) : Scheme :=
   260	  h.carrier.toScheme
   261	
   262	/-- The canonical open immersion into the genus divisor representer. -/
   263	def divRankOneOpenMap (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi) :
   264	    DivRankOneOpen pi h ⟶ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left :=
   265	  h.carrier.ι
   266	
   267	theorem divRankOneOpen_isOpenImmersion
   268	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi) :
   269	    IsOpenImmersion (divRankOneOpenMap pi h) := by
   270	  change IsOpenImmersion h.carrier.ι
   271	  infer_instance
   272	
   273	/- The scheme-level certificate also has the presheaf form consumed by relative-open inverse
   274	   constructions.  This is conditional only on the explicit carrier witness above. -/
   275	theorem divRankOneOpenMap_presheaf_isOpenImmersion
   276	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi) :
   277	    IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (yoneda.map (divRankOneOpenMap pi h)) := by
   278	  exact MorphismProperty.relative_map (divRankOneOpen_isOpenImmersion pi h)
   279	
   280	/-- The open represented object, retained in the slice over `Spec k` for consumers of the affine
   281	divisor functor. -/
   282	def divRankOneOpenOver (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi) :
   283	    Over (Spec (.of k)) :=
   284	  Over.mk (divRankOneOpenMap pi h ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom)
   285	
   286	/-- The inclusion of the certified open, as a morphism in the slice over `Spec k`.
   287	
   288	This is the map whose Yoneda action is consumed by the canonical rank-one Abel inverse.  Naming
   289	it separately keeps consumers independent of the implementation spelling of `divRankOneOpenOver`.
   290	-/
   291	def divRankOneOpenOverMap (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi) :
   292	    divRankOneOpenOver pi h ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C :=
   293	  Over.homMk (divRankOneOpenMap pi h)
   294	
   295	/-- Pull back the certified rank-one open along an arbitrary slice morphism. -/
   296	def divRankOneOpenPullback
   297	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi)
   298	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (q : T ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C) : T.left.Opens :=
   299	  q.left ⁻¹ᵁ h.carrier
   300	
   301	theorem divRankOneOpenPullback_isOpenImmersion
   302	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi)
   303	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (q : T ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C) :
   304	    IsOpenImmersion (divRankOneOpenPullback pi h q).ι := by
   305	  infer_instance
   306	
   307	/-- The arbitrary slice pullback remains an open immersion after passing to Yoneda. -/
   308	theorem divRankOneOpenPullbackMap_presheaf_isOpenImmersion
   309	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi)
   310	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (q : T ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C) :
   311	    IsOpenImmersion.presheaf
   312	      (yoneda.map (divRankOneOpenPullback pi h q).ι) := by
   313	  exact MorphismProperty.relative_map (divRankOneOpenPullback_isOpenImmersion pi h q)
   314	
   315	/-- Pointwise form of arbitrary base-change compatibility for the certified open. -/
   316	theorem mem_divRankOneOpenPullback_iff
   317	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi)
   318	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (q : T ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C)
   319	    (x : T.left) :
   320	    x ∈ divRankOneOpenPullback pi h q ↔ q.left.base x ∈ h.carrier := by
   321	  rfl

   323	/-- The universal predicate is exactly the represented preimage used by the Abel restriction. -/
   324	theorem divRankOneUniversalPredicate_eq_preimage :
   325	    divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi = divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi :=
   326	  rfl
   327	
   328	/-- The certified open carrier has the universal rank-one predicate as its Yoneda range. -/
   329	theorem divRankOneOpen_carrier_eq
   330	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi) :
   331	    openSubfunctor (divRepAffGenusScheme C) h.carrier =
   332	      divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi :=
   333	  h.carrier_eq
   334	
   335	/-- Pointwise form of the witness equality, exposing the exact contract consumed by an inverse.
   336	
   337	The right-hand side is the range of the open immersion, so a consumer can use this theorem to
   338	replace a rank-one predicate proof by a factorisation through `DivRankOneOpen pi h`. -/
   339	theorem divRankOneOpen_mem_iff
   340	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi)
   341	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   342	    (x : (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)).obj T) :
   343	    x ∈ (divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi).obj T ↔
   344	      x ∈ (openSubfunctor (divRepAffGenusScheme C) h.carrier).obj T := by
   345	  rw [h.carrier_eq]
   346	
   347	/-- A point of the universal rank-one predicate factors through the certified open immersion.
   348	
   349	Unlike a bare range-membership proof, the conclusion exposes the source point and the equality
   350	of its image with the given divisor point, which is the exact data needed by a canonical inverse. -/
   351	theorem divRankOneOpen_mem_iff_factorization
   352	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi)
   353	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   354	    (x : (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)).obj T) :
   355	    x ∈ (divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi).obj T ↔
   356	      ∃ y : (yoneda.obj (Over.mk
   357	          (h.carrier.ι ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom))).obj T,
   358	        (openSubfunctorMap (divRepAffGenusScheme C) h.carrier).app T y = x := by
   359	  rw [divRankOneOpen_mem_iff pi h x, openSubfunctor_mem_iff]
   360	
   361	/-- The same factorisation contract with the named open object and slice inclusion.
   362	
   363	The source in the preceding theorem is definitionally the slice object
   364	`divRankOneOpenOver pi h`; this corollary gives the stable public names expected by inverse
   365	consumers. -/
   366	theorem divRankOneOpen_mem_iff_factorization_over
   367	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) pi)
   368	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   369	    (x : (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)).obj T) :

    11	
    12	`PicRankOneOpen` is the functorial locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer whose pullback to
    13	every affine test admits a tied `PicRankOneLocalPresentation`.  Quantifying after every affine
    14	pullback makes the condition intrinsic on arbitrary test schemes; stability under further
    15	pullback is exactly `picEtMap_comp`.

    17	The remaining declarations form the corresponding preimages in the widened divisor functor and
    18	in its canonical representing Yoneda functor, together with the restricted Abel transformations.
    19	These are logical subfunctors only.  In particular, this file does not assert that
    20	`PicRankOneOpen` is represented by an open subscheme.  The relative-openness acceptance gate and
    21	the conditional universal-divisor carrier contract are exposed separately in `DivRankOneOpen.lean`.
    22	-/
    23	
    24	set_option autoImplicit false

    33	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}

    40	/-- The rank-one presentation locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer.
    41	
    42	Membership means that every affine pullback of the input plus class admits a local presentation
    43	tied to that pullback.  This is the correct logical subfunctor underlying the future open Picard
    44	locus; no openness or representability assertion is part of this definition. -/
    45	def PicRankOneOpen :
    46	    Subfunctor (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) where
    47	  obj T := {lam | ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    48	      (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    49	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    50	      ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))}

    52	    let F := picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)
    53	    have e : F.map t.op (F.map f lam) = F.map (t ≫ f.unop).op lam := by
    54	      apply Subtype.ext
    55	      exact (picEtMap_comp C f.unop t lam.1).symm
    56	    rw [e]
    57	    exact hlam A (t ≫ f.unop)

    59	/-! ## The public membership contract -/

    61	/-- The exact producer predicate for the rank-one locus.
    62

    65	`PicRankOneLocalPresentation` structure for the pulled-back class. -/

   139	    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
   140	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))) where
   141	  W : X.Opens

   147	    (w : S ⟶ X),
   148	    (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (Opposite.op S) v =
   149	      g.app (Opposite.op S) w →
   150	    ∃ u : S ⟶ (W : Scheme.{u}),

   197	    {X Z : Scheme.{u}}
   198	    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
   199	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)))
   200	    (fst : yoneda.obj Z ⟶
   201	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor)
   202	    (snd : Z ⟶ X)
   203	    (hpb : IsPullback fst (yoneda.map snd) (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi) g) :
   204	    IsOpenImmersion snd :=
   205	  h.property g fst snd hpb
   206	
   207	/-- Pullback stability of the public rank-one locus, exposed independently of its definition. -/
   208	theorem picRankOneOpen_map_mem {T T' : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   209	    (f : T ⟶ T') {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
   210	    (h : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T) :
   211	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map f lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T' :=
   212	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).map f h
   213	
   214	/-- Pullback stability of the public locus, with the base-change direction made explicit. -/
   215	theorem picRankOneOpen_baseChange_mem {T T' : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   216	    (f : T ⟶ T') {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
   217	    (h : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T) :
   218	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map f lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T' :=
   219	  picRankOneOpen_map_mem pi f h
   220	
   221	/-- The inverse image of `PicRankOneOpen` under the affine widened Abel transformation.
   222	
   223	This name deliberately records only a presentation-theoretic preimage.  It is not the future
   224	open subscheme `DivRankOneOpen`. -/
   225	def divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff :
   226	    Subfunctor (divFunctorAff C (genus C)) :=
   227	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).preimage (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C))
   228	
   229	/-- The same presentation preimage on the Yoneda functor of the canonical genus divisor
   230	representer. -/
   231	def divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter :
   232	    Subfunctor (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)) :=
   233	  (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).preimage
   234	    (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom
   235	
   236	/-- The affine Abel transformation restricted to the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
   237	def rankOneAbelAff :
   238	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).toFunctor ⟶
   239	      (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor :=
   240	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).fromPreimage (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C))
   241	
   242	/-- Restrict the canonical representation isomorphism to the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
   243	def rankOneRepresenterRestriction :
   244	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).toFunctor ⟶
   245	      (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).toFunctor :=
   246	  (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).fromPreimage
   247	    (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom
   248	
   249	/-- The represented genus Abel map restricted to the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
   250	def rankOneAbelRepresented :
   251	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).toFunctor ⟶
   252	      (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor :=
   253	  rankOneRepresenterRestriction pi ≫ rankOneAbelAff pi
   254	
   255	/-- Immediate consumer theorem: the restricted represented Abel map lands in the public locus.
   256	The stronger canonical inverse still needs the family-level divisor/evaluation producer; this
   257	theorem records the exact target API that consumer lanes can use today. -/
   258	theorem rankOneAbelRepresented_mem {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   259	    (x : (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).obj T) :
   260	    ((rankOneAbelRepresented pi).app T x :
   261	      (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T :=
   262	  ((rankOneAbelRepresented pi).app T x).property
   263	
   264	end
   265	
   266	end AlgebraicGeometry

    32	/-!
    33	# Native pullback comparison
    34	
    35	The datum-level `sectionsMap` is already linear over the structure-sheaf map and
    36	commutes with restriction.  It therefore gives a morphism from the native module
    37	to the pushforward of the base-changed native module.  Its adjoint is the
    38	canonical comparison from the geometric pullback of `D.nativeModule` to the
    39	native module rebuilt from `D.baseChange B'`.
    40	-/
    41	
    42	/-- `sectionsMap`, assembled as an `O_{C_B}`-linear map into pushforward. -/
    43	noncomputable def nativeModuleSectionsMap :
    44	    D.nativeModule ⟶
    45	      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (relCurveMap C B B')).obj
    46	        (D.baseChange B').nativeModule :=
    47	  ⟨PresheafOfModules.homMk
    48	    { app := fun U ↦ AddCommGrpCat.ofHom <| AddMonoidHom.mk'
    49	        (fun s ↦ D.sectionsMap B' le_rfl s)
    50	        (fun s t ↦ D.sectionsMap_add B' le_rfl s t)
    51	      naturality := fun {U V} i ↦ by
    52	        ext s
    53	        change D.sectionsMap B' le_rfl
    54	            (gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit i.unop.le s) =
    55	          gluedRes B' (D.baseChange B').pieces (D.baseChange B').unit
    56	            (Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono (relCurveMap C B B') i.unop.le)
    57	            (D.sectionsMap B' le_rfl s)
    58	        exact (D.gluedRes_sectionsMap B' i.unop.le le_rfl le_rfl
    59	          (Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono (relCurveMap C B B') i.unop.le) s).symm }
    60	    (fun U r s ↦ by
    61	      change D.sectionsMap B' le_rfl
    62	          (gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit le_rfl r s) =
    63	        gluedQsmul B' (D.baseChange B').pieces (D.baseChange B').unit le_rfl
    64	          (((relCurveMap C B B').app U.unop).hom r) (D.sectionsMap B' le_rfl s)
    65	      simpa only [Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app] using
    66	        D.sectionsMap_gluedQsmul B'
    67	          (W := U.unop) (W' := relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ U.unop)
    68	          (V := U.unop) (V' := relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ U.unop)
    69	          le_rfl le_rfl le_rfl le_rfl r s)⟩
    70	
    71	@[simp]
    72	theorem nativeModuleSectionsMap_app_apply (U : (relCurve C B).Opens)
    73	    (s : Γ(D.nativeModule, U)) :
    74	    (D.nativeModuleSectionsMap B').app U s = D.sectionsMap B' le_rfl s :=
    75	  rfl
    76	
    77	/-- The native module rebuilt from the base-changed datum receives the geometric
    78	pullback of the original native module.  This is adjoint to `sectionsMap` on
    79	every open, with no flatness or finiteness hypothesis on `B → B'`. -/
    80	noncomputable def nativePullbackComparison :
    81	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (relCurveMap C B B')).obj D.nativeModule ⟶
    82	      (D.baseChange B').nativeModule :=
    83	  ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
    84	    (relCurveMap C B B')).homEquiv D.nativeModule
    85	      (D.baseChange B').nativeModule).symm (D.nativeModuleSectionsMap B')
    86	
    87	/-- The adjunct of `nativePullbackComparison` is exactly the morphism assembled
    88	from the datum-level `sectionsMap`. -/
    89	@[simp]
    90	theorem nativePullbackComparison_adjunct :
    91	    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
    92	      (relCurveMap C B B')).homEquiv D.nativeModule
    93	        (D.baseChange B').nativeModule (D.nativePullbackComparison B') =
    94	      D.nativeModuleSectionsMap B' := by
    95	  exact Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _
    96	
    97	end
    98	
    99	end BasicOpenCocycleDatum

   101	end AlgebraicGeometry

     8	/-!
     9	# Degree-zero sections of the native rank-one module under coefficient change
    10	
    11	The glued datum already carries an unconditional ring-map equivalence on `H⁰`.
    12	This file transports that equivalence through `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.nativeModuleKSheafIso`,
    13	so the native `Scheme.Modules` object exposes the same comparison on its actual sections.
    14	The resulting map is an algebraic input to the canonical base-change mate; it does not assume
    15	that the mate itself is an isomorphism.
    16	-/
    17	
    18	set_option autoImplicit false
    19	
    20	universe u
    21	
    22	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace
    23	open scoped TensorProduct
    24	
    25	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    26	
    27	variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
    28	variable {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    29	variable {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
    30	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom pi]
    31	
    32	namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum
    33	
    34	noncomputable section
    35	
    36	variable (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
    37	
    38	local instance nativeSectionsModule (U : (relCurve C B).Opens) :
    39	    Module B Γ(D.nativeModule, U) :=
    40	  Scheme.moduleKSections
    41	    (Over.mk (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B))) D.nativeModule U
    42	
    43	/-- Degree-zero datum cohomology, viewed as native-module sections. -/
    44	noncomputable def nativeH0SectionsEquiv :
    45	    Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0 ≃ₗ[B] Γ(D.nativeModule, ⊤) :=
    46	  (Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
    47	      (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C B : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
    48	      isTerminalTop D.sheaf).trans
    49	    (D.nativeModuleKSectionsEquiv (⊤ : (relCurve C B).Opens)).symm
    50	
    51	variable (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B'] [Algebra B B']
    52	  [IsScalarTower k B B']
    53	
    54	local instance nativeSectionsModuleBaseChange (U : (relCurve C B').Opens) :
    55	    Module B' Γ((D.baseChange B').nativeModule, U) :=
    56	  Scheme.moduleKSections
    57	    (Over.mk (relCurve C B' ↘ Spec (.of B'))) (D.baseChange B').nativeModule U
    58	
    59	/-- The native degree-zero base-change equivalence, obtained by transport from
    60	`datumH0BaseChange`; no `IsIso` statement is used as an input. -/
    61	noncomputable def nativeH0BaseChange
    62	    (hH1 : Subsingleton (datumPair D).H1) :
    63	    B' ⊗[B] Γ(D.nativeModule, ⊤) ≃ₗ[B']
    64	      Γ((D.baseChange B').nativeModule, ⊤) :=
    65	  ((D.nativeH0SectionsEquiv).symm.lTensor B').trans
    66	    ((D.datumH0BaseChange B' hH1).trans
    67	      ((D.baseChange B').nativeH0SectionsEquiv B').symm)
    68	
    69	@[simp]
    70	lemma nativeH0BaseChange_one_tmul
    71	    (hH1 : Subsingleton (datumPair D).H1) (x : Γ(D.nativeModule, ⊤)) :
    72	    D.nativeH0BaseChange B' hH1 (1 ⊗ₜ[B] x) =
    73	      ((D.baseChange B').nativeH0SectionsEquiv B')
    74	        (D.datumH0BaseChange B' hH1
    75	          (1 ⊗ₜ[B] (D.nativeH0SectionsEquiv).symm x)) := by
    76	  rfl
    77	
    78	end

     8	/-!
     9	# The rank-one evaluation zero-locus comparison
    10	
    11	The canonical inverse is cut out by the evaluation counit, while the existing divisor engine
    12	consumes the tied cocycle datum's local equations.  This file proves the section-level comparison
    13	between those two descriptions before any Noetherian or regularity hypothesis is introduced.
    14	
    15	For a tied local presentation, transporting a datum section through `module_iso.inv` commutes
    16	with restriction to every open.  Since every component of the sheaf isomorphism is injective,
    17	restriction vanishes on the module side exactly when it vanishes on the datum side.  Applying
    18	this to the canonical unit-lift through the evaluation counit identifies its restriction-
    19	vanishing predicate with that of `datumSection`.  The final theorem specializes the comparison
    20	to `PicRankOneNativePresentation`, whose converted module is definitionally the native module.
    21	
    22	The second half passes to the canonical `O_X`-linear piece trivializations of the native module.
    23	It proves that the evaluated section has coordinate `datum.component` on every cocycle piece, and
    24	hence that the two principal local ideals agree.  This closes the local equation comparison, but
    25	does not yet glue those ideals into a base-change-compatible family-level evaluation divisor.  The
    26	file also does not assert regularity or manufacture the still-missing arbitrary-affine presentation
    27	producer.
    28	-/
    29	
    30	set_option autoImplicit false
    31	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    32	
    33	universe u
    34	
    35	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
    36	  CartesianMonoidalCategory
    37	
    38	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    39	
    40	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    41	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    42	
    43	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    44	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    45	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    46	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    47	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
    48	variable {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
    49	
    50	namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum
    51	
    52	variable {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
    53	
    54	/-- The coordinate of a native global section on one cocycle piece.
    55	
    56	This is obtained by restricting the section to `D.pieces j` and applying the canonical
    57	`O_X`-linear trivialization of the native module there. -/
    58	noncomputable def nativePieceCoordinate
    59	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
    60	    (s : Γ(D.nativeModule, (⊤ : (relCurve C B).Opens)))
    61	    (j : D.index) : Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces j) :=
    62	  gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j le_rfl
    63	    (gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit
    64	      (le_top : D.pieces j ≤ (⊤ : (relCurve C B).Opens)) s)
    65	
    66	/-- The native coordinate is the datum component of the same global section. -/
    67	theorem nativePieceCoordinate_eq_component
    68	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
    69	    (s : Γ(D.nativeModule, (⊤ : (relCurve C B).Opens)))
    70	    (j : D.index) :
    71	    D.nativePieceCoordinate s j = D.component s j := by
    72	  rw [nativePieceCoordinate, gluedTriv_apply, gluedRes_coe]
    73	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom]
    74	
    75	/-- The inverse of the native base-ring section equivalence is the identity on underlying
    76	sections. -/
    77	@[simp]
    78	theorem nativeModuleKSectionsEquiv_symm_apply
    79	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
    80	    (U : (relCurve C B).Opens) (s : D.sheaf.obj.obj (op U)) :
    81	    (D.nativeModuleKSectionsEquiv U).symm s = s := by
    82	  apply (D.nativeModuleKSectionsEquiv U).injective
    83	  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    84	  rfl
    85	
    86	/-- The inverse component of the native base-ring sheaf isomorphism is the identity on
    87	underlying sections. -/
    88	@[simp]
    89	theorem nativeModuleKSheafIso_inv_app
    90	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
    91	    (U : (relCurve C B).Opens) (s : D.sheaf.obj.obj (op U)) :
    92	    (D.nativeModuleKSheafIso.inv.hom.app (op U)).hom s = s := by
    93	  change (D.nativeModuleKSectionsEquiv U).symm s = s
    94	  exact D.nativeModuleKSectionsEquiv_symm_apply U s
    95	
    96	end BasicOpenCocycleDatum
    97	
    98	namespace PicRankOneLocalPresentation
    99	
   100	/-- Transport through the tied sheaf isomorphism commutes with restriction on sections. -/
   101	theorem module_iso_inv_restrict
   102	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   103	    {U V : (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier).Opens} (h : V ≤ U)
   104	    (s : P.datum.sheaf.obj.obj (op U)) :
   105	    (((Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
   106	      (Over.mk (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)))
   107	        P.module).obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
   108	      ((P.module_iso.inv.hom.app (op U)).hom s)) =
   109	      (P.module_iso.inv.hom.app (op V)).hom
   110	        ((P.datum.sheaf.obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom s) := by
   111	  exact congrArg (fun z => z.hom s)
   112	    (P.module_iso.inv.hom.naturality (homOfLE h).op).symm
   113	
   114	/-- Restriction vanishes after transport to the base-ring module exactly when the datum restriction
   115	vanishes.  This is a pointwise section comparison supplied by `module_iso`; it is not a statement
   116	about the native `O_X`-module ideal and needs no Noetherian hypothesis. -/
   117	theorem module_iso_inv_restrict_eq_zero_iff
   118	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   119	    {U V : (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier).Opens} (h : V ≤ U)
   120	    (s : P.datum.sheaf.obj.obj (op U)) :
   121	    (((Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
   122	      (Over.mk (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)))
   123	        P.module).obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
   124	      ((P.module_iso.inv.hom.app (op U)).hom s) = 0) ↔
   125	      ((P.datum.sheaf.obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom s = 0) := by
   126	  rw [P.module_iso_inv_restrict h s]
   127	  exact map_eq_zero_iff _
   128	    (CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso
   129	      (P.module_iso.inv.hom.app (op V))).1
   130	
   131	/-- The evaluation counit sends the canonical H⁰ unit-lift to the module section obtained
   132	from the tied datum class. -/
   133	theorem evaluation_evaluationLiftOfH0_eq_moduleSectionsEquiv
   134	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   135	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) :
   136	    (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app P.evaluation
   137	      ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
   138	        (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens))).hom
   139	      (P.evaluationLiftOfH0 y) = P.moduleSectionsEquiv y := by
   140	  calc
   141	    _ = P.pushforwardSectionOfH0 y := P.evaluation_evaluationLiftOfH0 y
   142	    _ = P.moduleSectionsEquiv y := rfl
   143	
   144	/-- The canonical evaluation section and the tied datum section have the same restriction-
   145	vanishing predicate on every open of the relative curve.
   146	
   147	This is the immediate consumer of `module_iso_inv_restrict_eq_zero_iff`: the evaluated section
   148	is first identified with `moduleSectionsEquiv y`, then with the inverse image of
   149	`datumSection y` under the presentation's sheaf isomorphism. -/
   150	theorem evaluationLift_restrict_eq_zero_iff
   151	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   152	    {V : (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier).Opens} (h : V ≤ ⊤)
   153	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) :
   154	    (((Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
   155	      (Over.mk (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)))
   156	        P.module).obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
   157	      ((Scheme.Modules.Hom.app P.evaluation
   158	        ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
   159	          (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens))).hom
   160	        (P.evaluationLiftOfH0 y)) = 0) ↔
   161	      ((P.datum.sheaf.obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
   162	        (P.datumSection y) = 0) := by
   163	  rw [P.evaluation_evaluationLiftOfH0_eq_moduleSectionsEquiv y]
   164	  rw [← P.module_iso_inv_datumSection y]
   165	  exact P.module_iso_inv_restrict_eq_zero_iff h (P.datumSection y)
   166	
   167	end PicRankOneLocalPresentation
   168	
   169	namespace PicRankOneNativePresentation
   170	
   171	/-- Native specialization of the evaluation/datum zero-locus comparison.
   172	
   173	`toLocalPresentation.module` is definitionally `P.datum.nativeModule`, so this theorem is the
   174	consumer-facing native base-ring section comparison rather than a second choice of line bundle.
   175	The native `O_X`-linear ideal comparison remains a separate producer obligation. -/
   176	theorem evaluationLift_restrict_eq_zero_iff
   177	    (P : PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam)
   178	    {V : (relCurve C P.toLocalPresentation.cover.Carrier).Opens} (h : V ≤ ⊤)
   179	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.toLocalPresentation.datum.sheaf 0) :
   180	    (((Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
   181	      (Over.mk (relCurve C P.toLocalPresentation.cover.Carrier ↘
   182	        Spec (.of P.toLocalPresentation.cover.Carrier)))
   183	        P.toLocalPresentation.module).obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
   184	      ((Scheme.Modules.Hom.app P.toLocalPresentation.evaluation
   185	        ((relCurve C P.toLocalPresentation.cover.Carrier ↘
   186	          Spec (.of P.toLocalPresentation.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
   187	          (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.toLocalPresentation.cover.Carrier)).Opens))).hom
   188	        (P.toLocalPresentation.evaluationLiftOfH0 y)) = 0) ↔
   189	      ((P.toLocalPresentation.datum.sheaf.obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
   190	        (P.toLocalPresentation.datumSection y) = 0) := by
   191	  exact P.toLocalPresentation.evaluationLift_restrict_eq_zero_iff h y
   192	
   193	/-- Under the native trivialization, the section attached to a datum `H⁰` class has the datum's
   194	component as its coordinate on every cocycle piece. -/
   195	theorem moduleSectionsEquiv_nativePieceCoordinate_eq_component
   196	    (P : PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam)
   197	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.toLocalPresentation.datum.sheaf 0)
   198	    (j : P.datum.index) :
   199	    P.datum.nativePieceCoordinate (P.toLocalPresentation.moduleSectionsEquiv y) j =
   200	      P.datum.component (P.toLocalPresentation.datumSection y) j := by
   201	  rw [← P.toLocalPresentation.module_iso_inv_datumSection y]
   202	  change P.datum.nativePieceCoordinate
   203	      ((P.datum.nativeModuleKSheafIso.inv.hom.app
   204	        (op (⊤ : (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier).Opens))).hom
   205	          (P.toLocalPresentation.datumSection y)) j = _
   206	  rw [P.datum.nativeModuleKSheafIso_inv_app]
   207	  exact P.datum.nativePieceCoordinate_eq_component _ j
   208	
   209	/-- The canonical evaluation counit section has `datum.component` as its coordinate under the
   210	native `O_X`-linear trivialization on every cocycle piece. -/
   211	theorem evaluationLift_nativePieceCoordinate_eq_component
   212	    (P : PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam)
   213	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.toLocalPresentation.datum.sheaf 0)
   214	    (j : P.datum.index) :
   215	    P.datum.nativePieceCoordinate
   216	        ((Scheme.Modules.Hom.app P.toLocalPresentation.evaluation
   217	          ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
   218	            (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens))).hom
   219	          (P.toLocalPresentation.evaluationLiftOfH0 y)) j =
   220	      P.datum.component (P.toLocalPresentation.datumSection y) j := by
   221	  rw [P.toLocalPresentation.evaluation_evaluationLiftOfH0_eq_moduleSectionsEquiv y]
   222	  exact P.moduleSectionsEquiv_nativePieceCoordinate_eq_component y j
   223	
   224	/-- The principal ideal cut out by the native evaluation section on a cocycle piece is exactly
   225	the principal ideal generated by the datum component consumed by the divisor engine. -/
   226	theorem evaluationLift_nativePieceIdeal_eq_componentIdeal
   227	    (P : PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam)
   228	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.toLocalPresentation.datum.sheaf 0)
   229	    (j : P.datum.index) :
   230	    Ideal.span {P.datum.nativePieceCoordinate
   231	        ((Scheme.Modules.Hom.app P.toLocalPresentation.evaluation
   232	          ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
   233	            (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens))).hom
   234	          (P.toLocalPresentation.evaluationLiftOfH0 y)) j} =
   235	      Ideal.span {P.datum.component (P.toLocalPresentation.datumSection y) j} := by
   236	  rw [P.evaluationLift_nativePieceCoordinate_eq_component y j]
   237	
   238	end PicRankOneNativePresentation
   239	
   240	end AlgebraicGeometry

    11	/-!
    12	# Descent-backed rank-one certificates for a tied cocycle datum
    13	
    14	This file is the cohomological half of the native family contract.  A certificate is attached to
    15	the displayed `BasicOpenCocycleDatum` and its displayed affine representative; it is never a
    16	certificate for a separately chosen module.  The only geometric input is the fibre witness
    17	condition (the mapped Čech class has a divisor with vanishing `H¹`), from which the datum
    18	dictionary and the rigid engine derive the three cohomological conclusions.
    19	
    20	The descent stage is essential: arbitrary coefficient rings need not be Noetherian.  We descend
    21	the finite cocycle datum to a finitely generated subalgebra, fire the engine there, and transport
    22	`H¹`, finite projectivity, and stalk rank through the on-the-nose datum H⁰ base-change
    23	equivalence.  Thus the public conclusions are genuinely arbitrary-affine, while the only
    24	Noetherian instance is local to the constructed stage.
    25	-/
    26	
    27	set_option autoImplicit false
    28	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    29	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    30	
    31	universe u
    32	
    33	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
    34	  CartesianMonoidalCategory
    35	open scoped TensorProduct
    36	
    37	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    38	
    39	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    40	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    41	
    42	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    43	variable {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
    44	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
    45	
    46	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    47	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    48	
    49	/-! ## The actual fibre antecedent -/
    50	
    51	/-- A field-parametrised vanishing witness for the *displayed* cocycle datum.
    52	
    53	This is deliberately an abbreviation for the landed `HasWitnessH1Vanishing` predicate.  In
    54	particular its divisor has the class of this datum's cocycle; it cannot be replaced by a witness
    55	for an unrelated module or class.  The stage constructor below asks for this predicate on its
    56	finitely generated descent datum, where every stage residue field is an admissible coefficient
    57	extension. -/
    58	abbrev BasicOpenCocycleDatum.FibreH1Witness
    59	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi) : Prop :=
    60	  ∀ (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra B L]
    61	    [IsScalarTower k B L], D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing L
    62	
    63	namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum
    64	
    65	/-- The fibre witness is converted through the landed two-way datum dictionary. -/
    66	theorem subsingleton_pairH1_tensor_of_fibreWitness
    67	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi) (hW : D.FibreH1Witness)
    68	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra B L]
    69	    [IsScalarTower k B L] :
    70	    Subsingleton ((datumPair D).H1 ⊗[B] L) :=
    71	  (D.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_subsingleton L).mp (hW L)
    72	
    73	end BasicOpenCocycleDatum
    74	
    75	/-! ## The certificate object -/
    76	
    77	/-- The four cohomological certificates consumed by the native presentation.
    78	
    79	Every module in this structure is the H-module of the same `D.sheaf`; no native or unrelated
    80	module can be substituted. -/
    81	structure RankOneFamilyCertificates
    82	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi) : Prop where
    83	  h1_vanishing : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 1)
    84	  h0_finite : Module.Finite B (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0)
    85	  h0_projective : Module.Projective B (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0)
    86	  h0_rank_one : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum B,
    87	    Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) p = 1
    88	
    89	namespace RankOneFamilyCertificates
    90	
    91	variable {D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi}
    92	
    93	/-! ## Canonical scalar extension -/
    94	
    95	/-- The canonical H⁰ equivalence attached to a certificate. -/
    96	noncomputable def h0BaseChange
    97	    (P : RankOneFamilyCertificates D)
    98	    (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B'] [Algebra B B']
    99	    [IsScalarTower k B B'] :
   100	    B' ⊗[B] (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) ≃ₗ[B']
   101	      Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange B').sheaf 0 := by
   102	  exact D.datumH0BaseChange B' ((subsingleton_datumPair_h1_iff D).mpr P.h1_vanishing)
   103	
   104	omit [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   105	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] in
   106	/-- H¹ vanishing is preserved by the same canonical coefficient extension. -/
   107	theorem h1_baseChange
   108	    (P : RankOneFamilyCertificates D)
   109	    (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B'] [Algebra B B']
   110	    [IsScalarTower k B B'] :
   111	    Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange B').sheaf 1) :=
   112	  D.datum_subsingleton_h1_baseChange B'
   113	    ((subsingleton_datumPair_h1_iff D).mpr P.h1_vanishing)
   114	
   115	/- The finite/projective instances for a tensor product are installed in the next constructor,
   116	   where they are used to transport the package's source module along `h0BaseChange`. -/
   117	
   118	/-- Scalar extension transports all four certificates, with the target still `D.baseChange`. -/
   119	noncomputable def scalarExtension
   120	    (P : RankOneFamilyCertificates D)
   121	    (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B'] [Algebra B B']
   122	    [IsScalarTower k B B'] :
   123	    RankOneFamilyCertificates (D.baseChange B') := by
   124	  let Q := Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0
   125	  letI : Module.Finite B Q := P.h0_finite
   126	  letI : Module.Projective B Q := P.h0_projective
   127	  let e : B' ⊗[B] Q ≃ₗ[B']
   128	      Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange B').sheaf 0 := P.h0BaseChange B'
   129	  letI : Module.Finite B' (B' ⊗[B] Q) := by infer_instance
   130	  letI : Module.Projective B' (B' ⊗[B] Q) := by infer_instance
   131	  refine {
   132	    h1_vanishing := P.h1_baseChange B'
   133	    h0_finite := Module.Finite.equiv e
   134	    h0_projective := Module.Projective.of_equiv e
   135	    h0_rank_one := ?_ }
   136	  intro p
   137	  rw [← Module.rankAtStalk_eq_of_equiv e, Module.rankAtStalk_baseChange]
   138	  exact P.h0_rank_one (p.comap (algebraMap B B'))
   139	
   140	end RankOneFamilyCertificates
   141	
   142	end AlgebraicGeometry

    10	
    11	/-!
    12	# Arbitrary-ring production of rank-one family certificates
    13	
    14	The rigid engine is Noetherian, but the public certificate is not.  This file applies the engine
    15	to a genuine finitely generated descent datum and transports its conclusions back to the original
    16	unrestricted coefficient ring by the canonical datum H0 base-change equivalence.
    17	-/
    18	
    19	set_option autoImplicit false
    20	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    21	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    22	
    23	universe u
    24	
    25	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
    26	  CartesianMonoidalCategory
    27	open scoped TensorProduct
    28	
    29	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    30	
    31	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    32	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    33	
    34	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    35	variable {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
    36	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
    37	
    38	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    39	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    40	
    41	namespace RankOneFamilyCertificates
    42	
    43	variable {D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi}
    44	
    45	/- The standard base-change geometry is keyed by the structure morphism supplied by
    46	`relCurve.instOver`; re-key it locally so the rank theorem sees the same `Over` object. -/
    47	noncomputable local instance (priority := 20000) rankOneCertificateOver
    48	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    49	    (relCurve C L).Over (Spec (.of L)) :=
    50	  instOverBaseChange C L
    51	
    52	noncomputable local instance rankOneCertificateSmooth
    53	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    54	    SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (.of L)) :=
    55	  instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionBaseChange C L
    56	
    57	noncomputable local instance rankOneCertificateIntegral
    58	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    59	    IsIntegral (relCurve C L) :=
    60	  instIsIntegralBaseChange C L
    61	
    62	noncomputable local instance rankOneCertificateQuasiCompact
    63	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    64	    QuasiCompact (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (.of L)) :=
    65	  instQuasiCompactBaseChange C L
    66	
    67	noncomputable local instance rankOneCertificateFiniteH0
    68	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    69	    Module.Finite L (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 0) :=
    70	  instModuleFiniteHModuleZeroBaseChange C L
    71	
    72	noncomputable local instance rankOneCertificateFiniteH1
    73	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    74	    Module.Finite L (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 1) :=
    75	  instModuleFiniteHModuleOneBaseChange C L
    76	
    77	set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
    78	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 400000 in
    79	/-- Construct the certificate package after a genuine finitely generated descent stage.
    80	
    81	`hW0` is the fibre-divisor/H1 antecedent at the stage and `hdegree` is the corresponding
    82	class-degree calculation.  Neither field mentions the desired global H1/H0/rank conclusions.
    83	The Noetherian instance is created only for `B0`; the result is over the original, unrestricted
    84	ring `B` by the canonical datum base-change equivalence. -/
    85	noncomputable def ofDescentStage
    86	    {B0 : Subalgebra k B} (hfg : B0.FG)
    87	    (D0 : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C (B0 : Type u) pi)
    88	    (hbc : D0.baseChange (B' := B) = D)
    89	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
    90	    (hW0 : D0.FibreH1Witness)
    91	    (hdegree : forall p : PrimeSpectrum (B0 : Type u),
    92	      classDeg p.asIdeal.ResidueField
    93	        (D0.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).cechPicClass = (genus C : Int)) :
    94	    RankOneFamilyCertificates D := by
    95	  subst D
    96	  letI : IsNoetherianRing (B0 : Type u) := hfg.isNoetherianRing
    97	  have hfib : forall p : PrimeSpectrum (B0 : Type u),
    98	      Subsingleton ((datumPair D0).H1 ⊗[B0] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) := by
    99	    intro p
   100	    exact D0.subsingleton_pairH1_tensor_of_fibreWitness hW0 p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   101	  obtain ⟨h1, hfinite, hprojective⟩ :=
   102	    BasicOpenCocycleDatum.descentRigidEngine hfg D0 hpi hfib
   103	  have hpair : Subsingleton (datumPair D0).H1 :=
   104	    (subsingleton_datumPair_h1_iff D0).mpr h1
   105	  have hrank : forall p : PrimeSpectrum (B0 : Type u),
   106	      Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule D0.sheaf 0) p = 1 := by
   107	    intro p
   108	    haveI : IsIntegral (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
   109	      instIsIntegralBaseChange C p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   110	    haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
   111	        (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField ↘
   112	          Spec (CommRingCat.of p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) :=
   113	      instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionBaseChange C p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   114	    haveI : QuasiCompact
   115	        (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField ↘
   116	          Spec (CommRingCat.of p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) :=
   117	      instQuasiCompactBaseChange C p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   118	    haveI : Module.Finite p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   119	        (Sheaf.HModule
   120	          ((relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).moduleKSheaf p.asIdeal.ResidueField) 0) :=
   121	      instModuleFiniteHModuleZeroBaseChange C p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   122	    haveI : Module.Finite p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   123	        (Sheaf.HModule
   124	          ((relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).moduleKSheaf p.asIdeal.ResidueField) 1) :=
   125	      instModuleFiniteHModuleOneBaseChange C p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   126	    exact BasicOpenCocycleDatum.rankAtStalk_hModule_zero_eq_one D0 (n := genus C) hpi
   127	      (chi_moduleKSheaf C) hfib p (hdegree p)
   128	  let Q := Sheaf.HModule D0.sheaf 0
   129	  letI : Module.Finite (B0 : Type u) Q := hfinite
   130	  letI : Module.Projective (B0 : Type u) Q := hprojective
   131	  let e : B ⊗[B0] Q ≃ₗ[B]
   132	      Sheaf.HModule (D0.baseChange (B' := B)).sheaf 0 :=
   133	    D0.datumH0BaseChange B hpair
   134	  letI : Module.Finite B (B ⊗[B0] Q) := by infer_instance
   135	  letI : Module.Projective B (B ⊗[B0] Q) := by infer_instance
   136	  refine {
   137	    h1_vanishing := D0.datum_subsingleton_h1_baseChange B hpair
   138	    h0_finite := Module.Finite.equiv e
   139	    h0_projective := Module.Projective.of_equiv e
   140	    h0_rank_one := ?_ }
   141	  intro p
   142	  rw [← Module.rankAtStalk_eq_of_equiv e, Module.rankAtStalk_baseChange]
   143	  exact hrank (p.comap (algebraMap (B0 : Type u) B))
   144	
   145	end RankOneFamilyCertificates
   146	
   147	end AlgebraicGeometry

     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOneLocusNative
     7	
     8	/-!
     9	# The canonical native rank-one presentation contract
    10	
    11	`PicRankOneLocalPresentation` deliberately leaves the geometric producer fields explicit.
    12	This file fixes the module part of that contract: for a tied cocycle datum `D`, the module is
    13	always `D.nativeModule` and its base-ring comparison is always
    14	`D.nativeModuleKSheafIso`.  The native piece trivializations supply the line-bundle field;
    15	arbitrary-cartesian pushforward base change and the cohomology/rank certificates stay as
    16	explicit obligations.
    17	
    18	The resulting contract is therefore an adapter interface for a future producer, rather than a
    19	second choice of a line bundle.  Its conversion is consumed directly by the public
    20	`PicRankOneOpen` membership theorem below; no unrelated module or untied class can enter
    21	through this bridge, and the adapter itself does not provide the geometric certificates.
    22	-/
    23	
    24	set_option autoImplicit false
    25	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    26	
    27	universe u
    28	
    29	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
    30	  CartesianMonoidalCategory
    31	
    32	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    33	
    34	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    35	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    36	
    37	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    38	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    39	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    40	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    41	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    42	
    43	/-! ## The native adapter contract -/
    44	
    45	/--
    46	A lambda-tied rank-one presentation whose module is canonically the native module of its
    47	cocycle datum.
    48	
    49	The fields after `datum_class` are exactly the remaining producer obligations.  The line-bundle
    50	certificate is derived from the canonical piece trivializations, so a field-level H⁰/H¹
    51	calculation or an unrelated line bundle cannot be silently substituted for the native
    52	evaluation module.
    53	-/
    54	structure PicRankOneNativePresentation
    55	    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)) : Type (u + 1) where
    56	  cover : Algebra.EtaleCover A
    57	  representative : descentClasses C cover
    58	  represents :
    59	    PicEtAff.mk C cover representative = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1
    60	  datum : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C cover.Carrier pi
    61	  datum_class :
    62	    (representative : relPic C (overSpec k cover.Carrier)) =
    63	      relPicMk C (overSpec k cover.Carrier) datum.cechPicClass
    64	  native_pushforward_base_change :
    65	    ∀ {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
    66	      (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    67	      (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C cover.Carrier)
    68	      (sq : IsPullback g' f'
    69	        (relCurve C cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) g),
    70	      IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app datum.nativeModule)
    71	  h1_vanishing : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 1)
    72	  h0_finite : Module.Finite cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
    73	  h0_projective : Module.Projective cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
    74	  h0_rank_one :
    75	    ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum cover.Carrier,
    76	      Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0) p = 1
    77	
    78	namespace PicRankOneNativePresentation
    79	
    80	variable {pi} {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
    81	
    82	/-- Convert the native adapter contract to the existing local-presentation contract.
    83	
    84	The two native bridge fields are inserted definitionally; all other fields are transported
    85	without weakening or adding hypotheses.
    86	-/
    87	noncomputable def toLocalPresentation
    88	    (P : PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam) :
    89	    PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam :=
    90	  { cover := P.cover
    91	    representative := P.representative
    92	    represents := P.represents
    93	    datum := P.datum
    94	    datum_class := P.datum_class
    95	    module := P.datum.nativeModule
    96	    module_iso := P.datum.nativeModuleKSheafIso
    97	    line_bundle := P.datum.nativeModule_isLineBundle
    98	    native_pushforward_base_change := P.native_pushforward_base_change
    99	    h1_vanishing := P.h1_vanishing
   100	    h0_finite := P.h0_finite
   101	    h0_projective := P.h0_projective
   102	    h0_rank_one := P.h0_rank_one }
   103	
   104	theorem nonempty_localPresentation
   105	    (P : PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam) :
   106	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) :=
   107	  ⟨P.toLocalPresentation⟩
   108	
   109	end PicRankOneNativePresentation
   110	
   111	/-! ## Immediate rank-one-locus consumer -/

    47	The equalities `hrep` and `hclass` tie the datum to the requested lambda class.  All four

+/-! ## The represented rank-one-divisor fibre square -/
+
+/-- The open `W` represents the pullback of the restricted divisor-class map along the displayed
+family, with its top map fixed by the canonical evaluation divisor.  This is stronger than the
+factorisation clause for the public rank-one locus: it is a categorical pullback against the
+entire restricted rank-one divisor presheaf. -/
+def EvaluationDivisorPullback
+    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) : Prop :=
+  IsPullback
+    F.evaluationDivisor
+    (yoneda.map F.W.ι)
+    (rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi)
+    g
+
+/-- The represented evaluation-divisor square produces the public-locus factorisation on every
+test scheme. -/
+lemma fibreFactorizationClause_of_evaluationDivisorPullback
+    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
+    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
+    F.FibreFactorizationClause := by
+  intro S v w hvw
+  have hS := (IsPullback.iff_app.mp hpb) (op S)
+  rw [Types.isPullback_iff] at hS
+  have hcompat :
+      (rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi).app (op S)
+          (E.divisor.app (op S) v) =
+        g.app (op S) w := by
+    have h := congrArg
+      (fun q => q.app (op S) v) E.divisor_toAmbient
+    change
+      (rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi).app (op S)
+          (E.divisor.app (op S) v) =
+        (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op S) v at h
+    rw [h]
+    exact hvw
+  obtain ⟨u, huDivisor, huW⟩ :=
+    hS.2.2 (E.divisor.app (op S) v) w hcompat
+  change E.divisor.app (op S) (F.fst.app (op S) u) =
+    E.divisor.app (op S) v at huDivisor
+  change u ≫ F.W.ι = w at huW
+  refine ⟨u, ?_, huW⟩
+  calc
+    F.fst.app (op S) u =
+        (rankOneAbelSigma pi).app (op S)
+          (E.divisor.app (op S) (F.fst.app (op S) u)) :=
+      (E.divisor_abel_app S (F.fst.app (op S) u)).symm
+    _ = (rankOneAbelSigma pi).app (op S) (E.divisor.app (op S) v) :=
+      congrArg _ huDivisor
+    _ = v := E.divisor_abel_app S v
